title: Candidate admission, diversity, ordering and display
purpose: Identify precisely where good candidates disappear and weak or repeated candidates enter or dominate the slate.

evidenceBasis.primaryOracle: The attributed editor review artifacts, reviewer dwaynetoler: reports/storypackage-02-future-volksgeist-v12-candidate-review.json with 48 decisions over 47 tasks, and reports/storypackage-02-jayz-drake-settle-it-v13-candidate-review.json with 12 decisions over 12 tasks. Job 1 hash-verified both against the evidence package.
evidenceBasis.whyThisOracle: These decisions are keyed taskId::candidateId and carry the editor's own words, so a complaint can be joined to the exact candidate and task. They are ATTRIBUTED, unlike the 49 matching_output_feedback records that Job 3 correction C-5 established carry packageId null (UE-22). Job 6 therefore rests on the attributed set and does not use the unattributed corpus as an oracle.
evidenceBasis.statusVersusComment: Status and comment are separate authorities and are not conflated. Future statuses are rejected 3, acceptable 11, unreviewed 34; Jay-Z are acceptable 2, unreviewed 10. Many unreviewed rows carry a substantive comment, including 'All acceptable selections', so unreviewed is a workflow state and NOT a rejection. Sentiment is read from the comment text only.

lineageCompleteness.limitation: 21 of the 47 reviewed future-volksgeist tasks have no focused-diversity record, so for those the admitted, hidden and not-admitted family sets are unknown and their findings are typed lineage_incomplete rather than guessed.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Eligibility and scope filtering
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.implementation: pipeline/media_candidates.py ok()/eligible pool; grammar/eligibility-overrides.json; binding record scope field
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: Eligibility is a pool filter applied before any capability reasoning. grammar/eligibility-overrides.json carries dated, attributed user admissions that override generated gates (selectorEligible false and catalogStatus reference_only_*), which is the correct place for such a decision. The binding scope field is observed only as 'lyrics' and _supports_operation rejects any record whose scope is set and is not the lyrics case, so scope is a narrow but real hard filter.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: none measurable at this stage from the committed artifacts

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Structured capability admission
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: Admission is driven by the single primary presentation operation against the structured capability record, never by prose or tags. It is generous in practice: the gallery holds 4896 candidate cards across 310 future-volksgeist tasks and 310 of 310 tasks have at least one candidate, with zero tasks left empty. Median admitted family count on focused tasks is 61 for future-volksgeist and 41 for jayz-drake.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: notAdmittedCatalogFamilies has a median of 38 of 97 catalog families for future-volksgeist and 61 of 97 for jayz-drake. Across the 38 fully-traced reviewed tasks, however, NOT ONE editor-requested family class fell in the not-admitted set, so no admission_error was evidenced.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Feasibility and unresolved native fit
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: Feasibility is a separate later pass and is deliberately conservative. Job 3 measured the 41-task run as templateVerdicts conditional 40 and incompatible 1, with zero native_fit, and Job 5 established why: any required media, text or typed data forces conditional because layer counts are explicitly not accepted as proof. The diversity artifact restates the boundary: 'An admitted family is eligible for editor review only; this report does not establish native fit.'
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: feasibility_unknown is the normal state rather than an exception. This is honest, and it also means feasibility cannot rank or filter the slate, so the editor receives candidates whose fit is undetermined.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.resolvesUE16: Job 3 UE-16 asked whether 40 of 41 conditional reflects honest uncertainty or a matcher that cannot conclude. Answer: honest uncertainty, structurally. The conditional verdict is forced by a stated evidentiary rule, not by an inability to compute; and Job 5 showed native editability is unknown for all 442 capability records, so a native_fit claim would be unsupported.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: B-roll and no-template routing
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: The produced route vocabulary is template_review 64 and broll 18, and brollFallbackAvailable is true on every task. media_candidates.py:7 states that a beat with no candidates is a FINDING rather than a failure, which is the right posture.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: none. In 16 of the 59 reviewed tasks the editor explicitly names b-roll or no-template as the correct route, and the route exists. These are typed valid_no_template_outcome and are NOT counted as pipeline failures.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Family and variant deduplication and diversity
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: The diversity pass measurably improves family variety: unique families across focused slates rise from 58 to 94 for future-volksgeist and 59 to 94 for jayz-drake. It achieves this by deduplicating to the FAMILY level.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: This is where the audit's primary finding sits. Deduplication is total: across all 484 slates in both packages, every family appears EXACTLY ONCE, with max variants-per-family of 1 on every task. 36 of 97 catalog families have more than one variant, and 32 of those 36 have variants that differ in slots_at_once, readable or structure. Variant is therefore where slot count and readability live, and variant choice never reaches the editor.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Relevance ordering
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: Ordering is explicitly and repeatedly fenced off from admission and fit. Candidate rows carry relevanceOrdering with scope 'ordering_only_not_admission_or_fit' (visualtask_matching.py:271) and the gallery declares 'ordering_only_not_admission_fit_selection_or_rendering' (storypackage_candidate_gallery.py:90). The ordering source is named as local-macos-natural-language.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: No ordering_loss was evidenced: because display takes a fixed 16 families by an explicit strategy rather than by a score cut, ordering does not silently drop a candidate.

stagesEvaluatedSeparately.name: Candidate display limits and focused-review sampling
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.finding: displayLimit is 16 on every focused task in both packages and slideshowLimit is 6 on every one. The sampling strategy is the same everywhere: eight_primary_plus_eight_least_exposed_admitted_families. The focused queue is editor-approved and records fullQueuePreserved.
stagesEvaluatedSeparately.observedLoss: The largest numeric loss in the pipeline. Hidden admitted family appearances total 1186 for future-volksgeist across 26 focused tasks and 1024 for jayz-drake across 33, i.e. 2210 in all, and EVERY focused task in both packages has hidden admitted families. Display retention is 25 percent of admitted families for future-volksgeist and 31 percent for jayz-drake: the editor sees about 16 of a median 61.
failureTypes: display_loss (3 evidenced against an editor request; systemic in magnitude)

failureTypeDefinitions.not_in_catalog: no catalog family can serve the requested class
failureTypeDefinitions.metadata_gap: the family exists and its capability record cannot express what the task needs
failureTypeDefinitions.contract_gap: the task never carried the information needed to request the right family
failureTypeDefinitions.admission_error: a catalog family that could serve the request was not admitted
failureTypeDefinitions.feasibility_unknown: fit could not be established, so the candidate reaches the editor undetermined
failureTypeDefinitions.ordering_loss: a candidate was admitted and displaced below the display cut by ordering
failureTypeDefinitions.display_loss: a family was admitted and then withheld by the display limit
failureTypeDefinitions.family_duplication: one family recurs across slates so that the slate reads as repetitive
failureTypeDefinitions.forced_template: a template route was proposed where no template was the right answer
failureTypeDefinitions.variant_collapse: NEWLY DEFINED BY THIS JOB. The right family reached the editor, but display deduplicates to one variant per family, so the specific variant whose slot count or readability the beat needs is unreachable. Distinct from display_loss, which withholds a whole family, and from metadata_gap, because the capability record is adequate and simply never consulted at variant granularity.
failureTypeDefinitions.displayed_but_rejected: DEFINED BY THIS JOB for honesty. The requested family class WAS displayed and the editor still judged the slate inadequate. This is not a retrieval, admission, ordering or display failure and must not be counted as one.
failureTypeDefinitions.valid_no_template_outcome: the editor names b-roll or no template as correct; a right answer, not a failure
failureTypeDefinitions.lineage_incomplete: the task has no focused-diversity record, so admitted and hidden sets are unknown

primaryFinding.statement: Good candidates mostly do not disappear at retrieval, admission or ordering. They disappear at display, in two distinct ways: whole families are withheld by a fixed 16-family cap, and within every family that does appear only one arbitrary variant is shown.
proof: Across all 484 slates in both packages every family appears exactly once; max variants-per-family is 1 on every task.
36 of 97 catalog families have more than one variant, and 32 of those 36 differ in slots_at_once, readable or structure.
Hidden admitted family appearances total 2210 across 59 focused tasks, and every focused task has some.
Display retention is 25 percent for future-volksgeist and 31 percent for jayz-drake.

whatIsNotTheProblem.claim: good candidates are filtered out by admission
whatIsNotTheProblem.basis: Across the 38 fully-traced reviewed tasks, not one editor-requested family class fell in notAdmittedCatalogFamilies. All six family classes the editor names, screen or document, comparison, portrait or intro, slideshow, timeline and evidence, exist in the 97-family catalog, so not_in_catalog is also unsupported for those requests.
Display takes a fixed 16 families by an explicit stated strategy rather than by a score cut, and ordering carries an explicit scope that excludes admission and fit. No ordering_loss was evidenced.

whatIsNotTheProblem.claim: the slate is dominated by repeated families
whatIsNotTheProblem.verdict: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED, AND NARROWER THAN EXPECTED
whatIsNotTheProblem.basis: The editor flags recurrence on 4 of 59 reviewed tasks, most sharply 'the selected carousel that keeps coming up and is usually irelevant finnaly is acceptable'. Against that, family deduplication is total within a slate and the diversity pass raises unique families from 58 to 94. The repetition the editor perceives is ACROSS slates, not within one, and the least-exposed-family half of the sampling strategy is the mechanism intended to address it.

whatIsNotTheProblem.claim: the system forces a template where none belongs
whatIsNotTheProblem.basis: brollFallbackAvailable is true on every task, the broll route is produced 18 times, and media_candidates.py states that a beat with no candidates is a finding rather than a failure. In the 16 reviewed tasks where the editor names b-roll the route exists. No forced_template instance was evidenced.

retrievalAdmissionOrderingDisplayNeverCo.verdict: SATISFIED, AND EVIDENCED BY FOUR SEPARATE BOUNDARY STATEMENTS IN THE ARTIFACTS
evidence: diversity boundary = 'An admitted family is eligible for editor review only; this report does not establish native fit.'
_presentation_candidates returns an evidenceBoundary of 'retrieval_is_candidate_discovery; fit_is_exact_evidence_comparison; neither_is_selection'
retrievalAdmissionOrderingDisplayNeverCo.auditDiscipline: This job reports each of the seven stages separately with its own measured loss and never aggregates them into a single score or rate.

evidence: pipeline/visualtask_matching.py contains no reference to prior, historical or carried choices; admission reads only the capability record.

pipeline/carry_prior_route_choices.py operates only on rows already at route template_review (line 41) and converts the route to template with a candidateId the editor already chose; it adds no candidate to any slate.
pipeline/visualtask_batch_matching.py treats prior-review reconciliation through _review_only (line 182) and as a named source, never as an admission input.
historicalEditorChoiceDoesNotAdmit.note: Job 1 AF-05 separately flagged that the harness gates baseline_reconciliation on a hardcoded total of 107, which is a generality risk but not an admission path.

evidence: brollFallbackAvailable true on every task; broll route produced 18 times against template_review 64
media_candidates.py:7 states that a beat with no candidates is a FINDING rather than a failure
16 of 59 reviewed tasks carry an editor request for b-roll or no template and are typed valid_no_template_outcome, explicitly NOT counted as failures
noTemplateRemainsValid.auditDiscipline: No finding in this job treats the absence of a template as a defect.

noCodeChanges.evidence: All analysis ran read-only from committed artifacts and read-only module inspection. Only the two Job 6 report files were created.

unresolvedEvidence.item: displayLimit 16 and slideshowLimit 6 are uniform across every focused task in both packages and no artifact states their derivation. Whether 16 is an editor preference, a UI constraint or an arbitrary default is not determinable here, and it is the single highest-leverage number in the pipeline.

The focused-review queue covers 26 of 310 future-volksgeist tasks and 33 of 186 jayz-drake tasks. coverageBasis has 5 entries but the sampling rationale for which tasks enter focused review is not reconstructable from the artifact alone.
21 of 47 reviewed future-volksgeist tasks have no focused-diversity record, so their admitted and hidden family sets are unknown and their findings are typed lineage_incomplete.

The editor twice named 06-the-history--scene-001 as perfect while the family was displayed under a different scene. Whether the editor could see which variant was offered, i.e. whether the review surface shows the variant id, cannot be established from these artifacts and bears directly on how to read every 'no good candidates' comment.
Mixed-payload handling has no effective consumer.
unresolvedEvidence.job6Note: Job 6 adds that no split route is produced in any artifact: the route vocabulary is template_review and broll only. Three reviewed tasks carry an editor request to split the beat, including 'beat should be split into 2', with no route able to express it.

acceptance.check: Retrieval, admission, ordering and display are never collapsed into one score
acceptance.basis: The report evaluates all seven stages separately, each with its own implementation, finding, measured loss and failure types, and never aggregates them. The separation is also verified in the artifacts themselves: five distinct boundary statements are quoted, including retrieval_only_not_fit, ordering_only_not_admission_or_fit and the diversity boundary that an admitted family is eligible for editor review only and that fit is not established.

acceptance.check: Historical editor choice does not admit a new-story candidate
acceptance.basis: Verified in code at three sites: the matcher has no reference to prior or carried choices and admits only from the capability record; carry_prior_route_choices acts only on rows already routed to template_review and adds no candidate; and the batch matcher treats prior-review reconciliation as review-only input. The audit's own oracle discipline matches: the editor's decisions are used to judge slates they were made against, never to admit a candidate elsewhere.

acceptance.check: No template remains a valid correct outcome
acceptance.basis: 16 of 59 reviewed tasks carry an explicit editor request for b-roll or no template and are typed valid_no_template_outcome, excluded from failure counts by definition. brollFallbackAvailable is true on every task and the broll route is produced 18 times. forced_template is explicitly recorded as NOT SUPPORTED, with the media_candidates statement that a beat with no candidates is a finding rather than a failure.

All analysis was read-only over committed artifacts and module inspection. git status shows only the two Job 6 report files; no production, grammar, evidence, gold-reference or earlier job output was modified.

result_detail.headline: Good candidates do not disappear at retrieval, admission or ordering. They disappear at display, twice over.
result_detail.oneLine: A fixed 16-family cap hides 2210 admitted family appearances across 59 focused tasks, and within every family that does survive only one arbitrary variant is shown, although 32 of 36 multi-variant families differ in exactly the slot count and readability the editor names as deciding.

reviewedTaskLineage.requirement: For every reviewed task used, the complete candidate lineage with editor response.
